assertions.text: The document gives a definite answer on the Northbank offer (accept, decline, or accept on stated conditions) as its own recommendation, rather than leaving the decision to Danny.
Nothing the document asks Danny to do before deciding extends past the August 14 offer deadline; any pre-decision steps fit inside the time remaining.
The document treats only about C$112,000 of the C$312,400 portfolio as spendable runway, because C$200,000 is committed to the 2028 house down payment under his and Sofia's written agreement.
The document cites Relay's specific figures (41 customers, or about US$780 a month of revenue) rather than describing its traction only in qualitative terms.

Using Relay's measured growth (9 customers added in six months) or a stated base rate for solo software products, the document assesses whether Relay could replace Danny's employment income, rather than assuming growth.
The Halyard contract is weighed as what the record shows: a single unsigned six-month arrangement, not a durable or diversified income stream.
The document names the pattern in Danny's reviews from both employers: strongest during incidents and novel or ambiguous problems, disengaged once work becomes routine maintenance.
The recommended course carries an observable sign, within a stated time window, that it is failing Danny.
No step in the plan requires leaving Toronto before Sofia's training ends in mid-2028.

When costing the independent path, the document states a monthly amount Danny personally must cover, computed from the C$7,900 household spend under a stated division between him and Sofia, rather than quoting only the household total.
The near-term cash arithmetic accounts for the wedding-fund contributions (about C$900 a month through April 2027).
The document names mid-2028, when Sofia finishes training and her income rises, as a decision point at which the independence question is deliberately reopened.
At least one recommended action is concrete enough to complete before August 14: a named message, question, or negotiation point directed at a named party.
The document analyzes both branches of the fork, the Northbank offer and the independent path, rather than only one of them.
